telegramBot.title: Telegram bot
telegramBot.description: Customers browse products, fill a cart and confirm an order inside Telegram. New customers are added to your list automatically.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: Up and running in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Register, add your company details, and start creating orders and receipts right away.

step1.title: Add your products and customers
step1.description: Add products with prices and stock levels. Add customers by hand, or let the Telegram bot add them when they place their first order.

step2.title: Create and confirm orders
step2.description: Build orders with several items and their own prices. Confirm them, track payment, and filter by date, status or amount.

step3.title: Generate and share receipts
step3.description: Click "Generate Receipt" and a PDF with your company details is made in the background. Download it, print it or share a link.

telegram.label: Telegram Bot
telegram.title: Sell directly inside Telegram
telegram.description: Your customers browse products, add them to a cart and confirm orders without leaving Telegram.

feat1.title: Full cart experience
feat1.description: Buttons in the chat, quantity input, stock checks, and an order review before confirming.

feat2.title: Automatic customer creation
feat2.description: A customer who writes to the bot is found by Telegram ID or created. They appear in your list right away.

feat3.title: Cart kept for 4 hours
feat3.description: A customer can leave and come back later to finish the order, even if the server restarts in between.
